answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The umber cap is upheld at intake and harbor shows the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a juniper tag. Each copy needs 5 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
